component.name: LionClip
component.summary: Search and reuse what you copied

description.p: LionClip is a small native clipboard-history utility for GNOME and Zorin OS. It records the text and images you copy, keeps them locally, and puts them back on the clipboard from a popup that opens near the pointer.
The history stays on the device: there is no account, no sync and no network access.
Desktop integration release: application ID, desktop entry, icon, autostart and Debian package.
